\usepackage{mathpartir}

% infixr:60 " → " => "\to"
% infix:55  " : " => ":"
% notation:53 x:atom ":" A:54 "∈" Γ:51 => x " : " A " \in " Γ
% infix:53  " ∉ " => "\notin"
% infixl:52 " , " => ","
% notation:50 Γ:51 "⊢" e:51 ":" A:51 => Γ " \vdash " e " : " A
% notation:56 "λ" x:atom ":" A:0 "." e:56 => "\lambda " x " : " A ".\," e
% notation:10 A:11 "type" => A "\;\mathsf{type}"
% notation:10 e:11 "term" => e "\;\mathsf{term}"
% notation:10 Γ:11 "ctx" => Γ "\;\mathsf{ctx}"

\begin{figure}
\begin{mathpar}
\inferrule*[right={S-Base}]
  { }
  {\iota\;\mathsf{type}}

\inferrule*[right={S-Arrow}]
  {A\;\mathsf{type} \\
   B\;\mathsf{type}}
  {A\to B\;\mathsf{type}}

\inferrule*[right={S-Var}]
  { }
  {x\;\mathsf{term}}

\inferrule*[right={S-Abs}]
  {A\;\mathsf{type} \\
   e\;\mathsf{term}}
  {\lambda x : A.\,e\;\mathsf{term}}

\inferrule*[right={S-App}]
  {e_{1}\;\mathsf{term} \\
   e_{2}\;\mathsf{term}}
  {e_{1}\,e_{2}\;\mathsf{term}}

\inferrule*[right={S-Empty}]
  { }
  {\emptyset\;\mathsf{ctx}}

\inferrule*[right={S-Extend}]
  {\Gamma\;\mathsf{ctx} \\
   A\;\mathsf{type} \\
   x\notin dom\,\Gamma}
  {\Gamma,x:A\;\mathsf{ctx}}
\end{mathpar}
\caption{STLC syntax}
\end{figure}

\begin{figure}
\begin{mathpar}
\inferrule*[right={T-Var}]
  {x : A \in \Gamma}
  {\Gamma \vdash x : A}

\inferrule*[right={T-Abs}]
  {x\notin dom\,\Gamma \\
   \Gamma,x:A \vdash e : B}
  {\Gamma \vdash \lambda x : A.\,e : A\to B}

\inferrule*[right={T-App}]
  {\Gamma \vdash e_{1} : A\to B \\
   \Gamma \vdash e_{2} : A}
  {\Gamma \vdash e_{1}\,e_{2} : B}
\end{mathpar}
\caption{STLC typing}
\end{figure}
